ReviewResult: PASS

The original MEDIUM path-traversal / write-outside-target finding is resolved.

- Static guard is applied before marker path construction/write and rejects `..`, absolute/rooted paths, drive-qualified paths, UNC/rooted forms after slash normalization, `"."`, `"./.."`, `"./_docs"`, `"_docs/.."`, and non-allowlisted zones.
- Allowlist is sourced from canonical `defaultZones()` / `SKELETON_DIRS`, not caller `opts.zones`.
- Realpath guard catches the seeded-zone junction/symlink escape by resolving the deepest existing ancestor before read/mkdir/write and requiring it under real `targetRoot`.
- Valid-zone behavior is preserved: write, idempotent unchanged rerun, and skip-if-modified all still work.

I also ran a focused probe against commit `0c802292` for dangerous zone forms, valid `_docs`, idempotency, modified-marker preservation, and `_docs` junction escape: `probe pass`.

Residual note: there is the usual non-atomic filesystem race between the realpath check and `mkdirSync`/`writeFileSync` if a concurrent local actor can mutate the target tree during execution. I do not treat that as a remaining bypass for the reported issue; pre-existing traversal and junction escapes are blocked.
